bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea at Feya Knightsbridge, surrounded by gorgeous, enchanted tropical forest-themed interiors.  The interior starts with a river of purple marble, leading you to Feya’s sunny sky, with a stop by the leafy rainforest, and bird cage seating.  The Afternoon Tea menu includes Smoked Salmon Roulade with Mango Cheese, Feta Cheese & Pistachio Bites and Mushroom & Broccoli Vol au Vent. A selection of mini patisserie is served with freshly baked scones, accompanied by jams and clotted cream.  Choose from a selection of premium teas, including English Breakfast, Earl Grey and Green Jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served on Saturdays and Sundays from 12pm to 6pm and costs £37.50 per person.  Feya Knightsbridge is located just opposite Harrods on Brompton Road.
